provider: NASA PDS Geosciences Node / MRO CRISM
instrument: Compact Reconnaissance Imaging Spectrometer for Mars (CRISM)
license: PDS archived data are in the public domain (NASA PDS Geosciences Node)
native_support: 36 m equirectangular (MRO Mars Equirectangular, custom sphere radius 3394839.813316312 m, standard parallel 15 N)
band_semantics: 489 bands 436.13-3896.76 nm, float32 reflectance factor; three detector gaps recorded; header wavelength vector agrees with the detached TAB
coverage: one map-projected targeted observation; footprint 18.2767-18.7324 N, 77.2756-77.5611 E
observation_states_enabled: unknown only; decoder failed the reproduction tolerance
limitations: Only 256-pixel sub-windows per AOI were read, not the full AOI, so valid_fraction is not asserted.
The DP information map values read as 0 with no validated SIS bit table; it is not used as a quality filter.
The official refined-summary values are context; they are not a detection or an abundance.
One granule is not a survey of Jezero crater or Mars.

provider: NASA PDS Imaging Node / Chandrayaan-1 M3 team
license: NASA Planetary Data System archived data (public domain)

assets.geometry: 304 samples x 21030 lines x 85 bands, BIL float32

band_semantics: RFL header exposes 85 explicit wavelengths in nm and 85 kernel widths; BIL layout makes a bounded row window a single contiguous range
coverage: single global-mode orbit strip (2009-02-03T17:51:31Z to 18:27:11Z); the lunar ROI (Shackleton rim) is not confirmed inside this strip
limitations: The RFL/SUP headers expose no per-pixel latitude/longitude; the PDS label states pixel-located data but geolocation depends on the archive GEOMETRY/SPICE products, which were not read.
SUP band 1 is a photometric-relative reflectance, band 2 an estimated surface temperature and band 3 radiance band 84; none is a geolocation backplane.
The 2.17 GB spectral cube was not downloaded; only headers and labels were read.
No M3 band-depth parameter or threshold is applied.
